# Aethera Digital

> Aethera Digital is a boutique creative, marketing and digital-systems studio. We connect brand, website, search, ads, content and back office into one customer journey. Tagline: Creative Direction. Connected Tools. Ongoing Progress.

## Services

- Brand Development & Design: positioning, identity and visual systems that make a business instantly recognizable.
- Website Development & Refinement: fast, clear sites that explain the offer and turn visits into inquiries.
- SEO & AI Search Visibility: getting found on Google and in AI answers, with content structured to be cited.
- Advertising & Funnels: campaigns and landing paths that bring in the right people at the right cost.
- Content, Social & Video: stories, posts and video that keep a brand present and worth following.
- CRM & Back Office: tagging, routing and automation so every lead gets followed up.
- Portals & Dashboards: client portals and live dashboards that put the right information in one place.
- Reporting & Strategy: monthly reporting with clear interpretation and the next actions to take.

## Ways to work together

- Individual projects: a focused build with a clear scope, such as a brand, a website, a campaign or a dashboard.
- Combined launch engagements: brand, site, search and lead follow-up launched together.
- Ongoing digital partnerships: month-to-month work to run, measure and refine the whole system.

## Startup Package

$2,250 per month, month-to-month with no long contract. Includes up to a 5-page website, one ad platform where it fits, a monthly report and one monthly strategy meeting. Ad spend, software, paid assets and third-party costs are billed separately.
